# Finance skill pack

Skills for accounting operations, planning and analysis, cash management, reporting, controls, tax preparation and sustainability reporting. Designed for finance teams in small and mid-sized companies, and for founders who are their own finance team.

**21 skills** · version 1.0.0 · EU and Denmark aware · works with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot (chat and code).

- Install in Claude Code: `/plugin install finance-skills --marketplace gifmaster/department-skills`
- Install anywhere else: see [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)
- Each skill folder has `SKILL.md` (for platforms that load skills) and `PROMPT.md` (copy-paste instructions for custom GPTs, Gems and Copilot agents).

## Skills

| Skill | Title | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`fin-month-end-close`](skills/fin-month-end-close/SKILL.md) | Month-End Close Checklist | Builds and runs a month-end close checklist with tasks, owners, deadlines and status, and highlights blockers to a faster close. |
| [`fin-bank-reconciliation`](skills/fin-bank-reconciliation/SKILL.md) | Bank Reconciliation | Reconciles bank statements against the ledger, matches transactions, explains differences and proposes correcting entries. |

## Suggested workflows

Skills work on their own, and chain well in these sequences.

### Close the month
From raw transactions to a management report with commentary.

`fin-month-end-close` → `fin-bank-reconciliation` → `fin-ap-invoice-coding` → `fin-expense-claim-review` → `fin-variance-analysis` → `fin-management-report-commentary`
### Plan and fund
Build the budget, test the cash runway and judge investments.

`fin-budget-builder` → `fin-cash-flow-forecast` → `fin-business-case` → `fin-unit-economics`
### Year end and audit
Get the annual accounts and audit done with fewer surprises.

`fin-annual-report-prep` → `fin-audit-prep` → `fin-internal-controls-review` → `fin-accounting-policy-memo`

## Built-in guardrails

- Show calculations and formulas so every number can be traced and checked. Never present an estimate as an actual figure.
- Do not give investment, tax or legal advice as a final answer. Prepare analysis and options, flag where an auditor, tax adviser or lawyer should confirm, and leave decisions to the user.
- Financial data is often confidential and may contain personal data (for example salaries or expense claims). Ask for anonymised or aggregated data where possible.

## Regulatory context used across this pack

- Denmark: the Bookkeeping Act (bogføringsloven) requires bookkeeping material to be kept for 5 years and phases in requirements for digital bookkeeping systems; the Financial Statements Act (årsregnskabsloven) sets reporting classes B, C and D.
- VAT, thresholds, filing deadlines and reporting classes change; confirm current figures with Skattestyrelsen, Erhvervsstyrelsen or your auditor.

These notes are orientation, not legal advice. Check current law, collective agreements and your own policies.
